MFA Reset.Work Notes:
{description}they need their MFA reset.
Verified via METHOD.
Found their Active Directory account in Active Roles, selected Other Properties tab, entered "TRUE" in the "Issue TAP" field.
Provided the TAP-Result field.
Instructed them to go to https://aka.ms/mysecurityinfo-usgov
Had them select Security info on the left hand side.
Had them select Add sign-in method next to the plus sign.
Had them select Microsoft Authenticator then next, next, scan the code, next, type in the code listed on their phone.
Verified the new method was showing up.
Had them remove the previous method.
{endnotes}
